# Model performance

## Model 1
```{r}
mp1 <- bu_res_sfh_mp1 %>% 
  select(-Projection_Share, -Precision_at_Projection_Share, -Precision_at_Projection_Share_SD) %>% 
  mutate(Model = "SFH parcels") %>% 
  bind_rows(bu_res_mfh_mp1 %>% 
  select(-Projection_Share, -Precision_at_Projection_Share, -Precision_at_Projection_Share_SD) %>% 
  mutate(Model = "MFH parcels") ) %>% 
  bind_rows(bu_nonres_mp1 %>% 
              select(-Projection_Share, -Precision_at_Projection_Share, -Precision_at_Projection_Share_SD) %>% 
  mutate(Model = "Non-residential parcels") ) %>% 
  bind_rows(nbu_mp1 %>% 
              select(-Projection_Share, -Precision_at_Projection_Share, -Precision_at_Projection_Share_SD) %>% 
  mutate(Model = "Non-built-up parcels")) %>% 
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 2))) 

mp1_paps <- bu_res_sfh_mp1 %>% 
  select(-Projection_Share, -Precision_at_Projection_Share_SD) %>% 
  mutate(Model = "SFH parcels") %>% 
  bind_rows(bu_res_mfh_mp1 %>% 
  select(-Projection_Share, -Precision_at_Projection_Share_SD) %>% 
  mutate(Model = "MFH parcels") ) %>% 
  bind_rows(bu_nonres_mp1 %>% 
              select(-Projection_Share, -Precision_at_Projection_Share_SD) %>% 
  mutate(Model = "Non-residential parcels") ) %>% 
  bind_rows(nbu_mp1 %>% 
              select(-Projection_Share, -Precision_at_Projection_Share_SD) %>% 
  mutate(Model = "Non-built-up parcels")) %>% 
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 2))) 

colnames(mp1) <- c("Model", "Bal. Accuracy", "Precision", "Recall", "F1", "ROC-AUC")
```

```{r}
out_path <- "./output_maps/table_mp1.docx"

if (file.exists(out_path)) {
  file.remove(out_path)
}

ft <- flextable(mp1)

ft <- ft %>%
  font(fontname = "Calibri", part = "all") %>%
  fontsize(size = 9, part = "all") %>%
  width(width = 16 / ncol(mp1), unit = "cm") %>%   # distribute total width across columns
  set_table_properties(layout = "fixed")

doc <- read_docx() %>%
  body_add_flextable(ft)

print(doc, target = out_path)
```

# Predicted vs. observed plots
```{r}
pred_obs_plot <- bu_res_sfh_pred %>% 
  transmute(predicted = .pred, observed = dep_var, model = "SFH parcels") %>% 
  bind_rows(bu_res_mfh_pred %>% 
  transmute(predicted = .pred, observed = dep_var, model = "MFH parcels")) %>% 
    bind_rows(bu_nonres_pred %>% 
  transmute(predicted = .pred, observed = dep_var, model = "Non-residential parcels")) %>% 
    bind_rows(nbu_pred %>% 
  transmute(predicted = .pred, observed = dep_var, model = "Non-built-up parcels")) 

pred_obs_plot$model <- ordered(pred_obs_plot$model, 
                                       levels = c("SFH parcels", "MFH parcels", "Non-residential parcels", "Non-built-up parcels"))
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, fig.width= 9, fig.height=3}
plot_pred_obs <- ggplot(pred_obs_plot, aes(x = observed, y = predicted)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4, size = 1.2, colour = "#3b528b") +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    x = "Actual values (log)",
    y = "Predicted values",
    title = "Predicted vs. observed"
  ) +
  theme_light() + 
  facet_wrap(~model, scales = "free", nrow = 1)+
  theme_minimal()

plot_pred_obs

ggsave(file="plot_pred_obs.svg", plot= plot_pred_obs, units = "mm",
       device = "svg", path = "./output_maps/", width = 190, height = 60)
```


# SHAP

## 1) SHAP Feature Importance as dataframe (mean |SHAP|)
```{r}
var_nam_short <- 
  var_nam %>% 
  select(var_name, var_names_paper)

shap_imp <- tibble(
  # feature = colnames(bu_res_sfh_shap_matrix),
  # mean_abs_shap = colMeans(abs(bu_res_sfh_shap_matrix))
    feature = colnames(bu_nonres_shap_matrix),
  mean_abs_shap = colMeans(abs(bu_nonres_shap_matrix))
) %>%
  arrange(dplyr::desc(mean_abs_shap)) %>% 
  left_join(var_nam %>% transmute(feature = var_name, 
                                  var_names_paper)) %>% 
  mutate(rank = row_number(), 
         plot_subheader = paste0("SHAP FI: ", round(mean_abs_shap, 3), " (", rank, ")"))

shap_imp %>% slice_head(n = 10)
```

## 2) Plots with shapviz

### SHAPdependence plots for all models
```{r}
plot_shap_dependence_9by9 <- function(shap_matrix, shap_df, title_parceltype) {
  
  shap_imp <- tibble(feature = colnames(shap_matrix),
                             mean_abs_shap = colMeans(abs(shap_matrix))) %>%
    arrange(desc(mean_abs_shap)) %>%
    left_join(var_nam %>% transmute(feature = var_name, var_names_paper),
                     by = "feature") %>%
    mutate(var_names_paper = coalesce(var_names_paper, feature)) %>% 
    mutate(rank = row_number(), 
         plot_subheader = paste0("SHAP FI: ", round(mean_abs_shap, 3), " (", rank, ")"))
  
  sv <- shapviz(shap_matrix, X = shap_df)
  
  shap_vals <- sv$S
  max_abs <- max(abs(shap_vals), na.rm = TRUE)
  ylim_global <- c(-max_abs, max_abs)
  
  top9 <- shap_imp %>% slice(1:9)
  
  plots <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(top9)), function(i) {
    feat <- top9$feature[i]
    nice <- top9$var_names_paper[i]
    sub <- top9$plot_subheader[i]
    
    sv_dependence(sv,
                  v = feat,
                  color_var = NULL,
                  alpha = 0.4) +
      ggtitle(nice, sub) +
      labs(x = "", y = "SHAP value") +
      coord_cartesian(ylim = ylim_global) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 'dotted', col = 'red') +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 7)+
      theme(
      # plot.title  = element_text(size = 10),
      # axis.title.x = element_text(size = 9),
      # axis.title.y = element_text(size = 9),
      axis.text   = element_text(size = 7)
      # strip.text  = element_text(size = 8),   # if facets appear
      # legend.title = element_text(size = 9),
      # legend.text  = element_text(size = 8)
    )
  })

  wrap_plots(plots, ncol = 3)   +
  plot_annotation(
    title = title_parceltype,
    theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 10))
  )
}
```
